deep_dives.title: First U.S. Navy Destroyer Enters Phase Two of DDG MOD 2.0 Modernization
deep_dives.what_happened: USS Pinckney becomes the first U.S. Navy destroyer to enter Phase Two of the DDG MOD 2.0 program, adding advanced SPY-6 radars to counter growing global threats. The post First U.S. Navy Destroyer Enters Phase Two of DDG MOD 2.0 Modernization appeared first on Naval News .

deep_dives.title: Hellenic Navy Conducts Inaugural SPIKE Missile Firings During Joint Drills with Israel
deep_dives.what_happened: Greece and Israel test new SPIKE NLOS and ER2 missile systems and sink a decommissioned frigate during joint Hellenic Navy live-fire drills in the Cretan Sea. The post Hellenic Navy Conducts Inaugural SPIKE Missile Firings During Joint Drills with Israel appeared first on Naval News .

deep_dives.title: On The Brink Of Epic Fury Round Two?
deep_dives.what_happened: Israeli Air Force operations, ship movements, ominous messaging and more point to the possibility that the war with Iran is about to erupt again. The post On The Brink Of Epic Fury Round Two? appeared first on TWZ .

deep_dives.title: GDIT announces Amy Johnson as new president
deep_dives.what_happened: Johnson replaces longtime president Amy Gilliland, who was let go from the company earlier this month after almost a decade of leading the business unit.

deep_dives.title: Space Force reveals first 6 ‘operational’ contracts for civil reserve support in space monitoring
deep_dives.what_happened: Space Systems Command officials said the contracts are an initial step for the Commercial Augmentation Space Reserve (CASR) initiative, and don’t address the thornier issues of US rights to deny other customers service or reimbursement for satellites lost in a conflict.

deep_dives.title: US military needs ‘urgent revolutionary institutional change’ to prepare for modern war, Petraeus says
deep_dives.what_happened: Ret. Army Gen. David Petraeus praised the Pentagon’s new Autonomous Warfare Command but said the U.S. must rapidly prepare for modern autonomous war.
